objective: Evaluate an evidence-based needs_human referral for Cali-Tree v2 that separates a visibly `partial` edit from an indeterminate case, and report the full evaluation suite from docs/calitree_goal.md (Metric 1 with ordinal MAE, Metric 2 auto accuracy + coverage, Metric 3 consensus-referral precision/recall/F1, plus tree-compression metrics).
baseline_preservation: Cali-Tree v2 and Rubric-Lite v4 are unchanged. The evidence referral is a new human_review_mode=evidence_policy on calitree_judge; human_review_mode=off reproduces the frozen v2 behavior exactly.

dataset.name: ImagenHub/Text_Guided_Image_Editing
dataset.development_status: The full 1,200-case ImagenHub set has been inspected repeatedly and is development/ablation data, not untouched confirmation.

interpretation_rule: Full-coverage classification (Metric 1) is primary and is measured on the underlying `label` for every case, including referred ones. Auto accuracy (Metric 2) must always be reported with coverage. needs_human is a deployment outcome, never a fourth class prediction, and never counted as correct. The perfect-human-review ceiling is not model accuracy. Referral quality (Metric 3) measures alignment with disputed human consensus and is separate from model-error capture.

comparison.paired_comparison_required: The evidence policy is compared against the existing selective_policy on the identical held-out cases; both preserve the same underlying three-class label.

reserved: The untouched EditInspector final 391-case partition is not part of this experiment and is not spent by it.
